system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"If I purchase Premium for Family, will family members who travel regularly to US & Canada still be able to access their music? Thanks"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"<USER> HI Julian, we can help. Can you fire over your account's email address via DM? We'll check under the hood and see what we can suggest /NY <URL>"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Reply is impersonal and requests email publicly; should be more helpful and private."}
